findings.quote: The growing use of AI-powered weapons and autonomous systems also requires urgent attention. One principle must remain clear: machines should never be allowed to make life-or-death decisions on their own.
findings.rationale: Discusses equitable AI access, UN-led international rules and human control over weapons, education harms, and beneficial use for peace and prevention.

findings.quote: With responsible use, proper human oversight, and good governance, we can move this technology away from the battlefield and towards diplomacy, mediation, and conflict prevention.
findings.rationale: Continues the preceding AI discussion by advocating responsible deployment for diplomacy and conflict prevention under human oversight.
